operations.details_summary: Read canonical HMLR exact matcher at current canonical HEAD.
HMLR official technical guidance states INSPIRE polygon data is captured against British National Grid.
HMLR warns BNG to WGS84 reprojection can shift some features by up to 15 metres.
Current INSPIRE delivery is official GML by local authority.
Canonical matcher accepts any readable source CRS instead of fail-closing on unexpected CRS for an official HMLR source.
When source CRS differs, Transformer.from_crs(..., always_xy=True) silently reprojects before exact-match evaluation.
Output records source_crs but not transformer definition, expected accuracy, area of use or ballpark status.
A converted vector can be treated like official HMLR geometry without a hash-bound conversion receipt to the official GML.
pyproj Transformer exposes operation accuracy and supports allow_ballpark / only_best controls.
PROJ documents ballpark transformations as unknown-accuracy approximations that may create large errors.
Direct official HMLR GML must resolve to a CRS equivalent to EPSG:27700; otherwise block.
Non-BNG converted intermediates require official-source SHA plus explicit conversion receipt before use.
Any permitted transform must record source/target CRS, operation definition, accuracy and area of use.
Disallow ballpark transformations for exact HMLR geometry normalization.
Require best-available transformation semantics where a conversion is explicitly permitted.
Persist pre-transform geometry WKB hash and normalized EPSG:27700 WKB hash.
For permitted transforms, record vertex displacement summary and transformed bounds.
Do not label geometry as exact HMLR source if CRS or transform provenance is unproven.
